title: Rainy Tape Hours
description: A slow lo-fi hip-hop loop in D minor at 75 BPM, swing 0.22: soft drums with a lazy snare and a quiet shaker, a warm bass, jazz chords (Dm7, Gm7, C7, Fmaj7) on an electric piano through a dull-filter, tape-warble chorus and room, a muffled harp melody and a rain texture underneath. Arranged as intro, two loops, a loop with the melody, a break and a closing loop and outro (36 bars, about 1 minute 55). Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
